name: Dilip Rakshit

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Dilip Rakshit is a bilingual poet whose literary work sits alongside painting. A 2024 contributor biography in Literary Vibes places him in Durgapur, West Bengal, and describes his work teaching English literature privately. The journal also published his poems ‘Station’, ‘Reminiscence’ and ‘A Cup of Tea’.

In his Kabita Live poem ‘From core to zeal world’, enclosed spaces give way to an intensely coloured world. Pods, shells and the womb become images of containment and emergence, while light and the senses draw life outward. Cyan, green, gold and yellow recur through the poem, making colour part of its movement from inward darkness towards experience.
